description: List the tenant's demand evidence records — durable research artifacts that give demand signals provenance (a URL, an excerpt, a structured claim about a market condition). Each row carries the scope (Item/Tag/Category), the claim, source details, review-by date, and status (Active/Superseded/Refuted). Default lists only active evidence; set activeOnly false to include superseded and refuted. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500 per call.

activeOnly.description: True (default) = only active evidence; false = include superseded/refuted.

name: list_demand_evidence
title: List Demand Evidence
